title: Lookalike-domain bank change in urgent Hinglish

request.raw_text:
Our MD needs this done in the next 20 minutes.

Hello ji, CEO sir khud wait kar rahe hain, abhi ke abhi karna hai!!

Humara bank account change ho gaya hai, purana HDFC wala band ho raha hai. Naya account:
A/c 9988 7766 5544, IFSC YESB0000789, Yes Bank Mumbai.
Aaj hi update karke pending payment bhej dijiye, warna supply ruk jayegi.

Vikram Sethi
CFO, Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd

If it slips, supplies stop from Monday. Jaldi kijiye please, checking baad mein.
